title: Jagged Tender Peruvian Potatoes Papa Rellena
description: A bitter and tender Peruvian dish featuring shallots and flambe, served in a mason jar, this papa rellena is a romantic and halal-friendly option for dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, toss the chopped potatoes with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika until they are evenly coated
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes
While the potatoes are roasting, heat the flambe sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat
Add the chopped shallots and minced garlic to the saucepan and cook until the shallots are caramelized
Once the potatoes are done roasting, let them cool slightly before filling mason jars with the potato mixture and topping with the flambe sauce and shallot mixture
Serve the papa rellena hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired
